question: Who is the first Indian woman to score a century in a pink-ball Test cricket match in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Smriti Mandhana**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Smriti Mandhana was the first Indian woman **to score a century in a pink-ball Test cricket match in 2021.
 
• Smriti Mandhana **scored 127 runs, including 22 fours and a six, on October 1, 2021.**
 
• **In 2021, she was honored with the Rachael Heyhoe Flint Award for the ICC Women's Cricketer of the Year.**
 
• Smriti Mandhana plays for the Royal Challengers Bangalore in the Women's Premier League.
 
• She also** represents Maharashtra in domestic cricket.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mithali Raj****​**

 
 
• India's Mithali Raj became the first women cricketer to score 7000 career runs in Women's One Day International Cricket.
 
• She has scoredAt 7805 runs in 232 matches international ODI matches at an average of 50.68.
 
• In 10 test matches, she has scored 663 runs which include 1 double century, 1 century, and 4 half-centuries.
 
• She is the only lady cricketer who score 2000 runs in Twenty20 Internationals (T20I).
 
• She is from Secunderabad, India.
 
 
 
• **Sneha Rana**
 
 
• She is **an Indian cricketer, made her Test debut on June 16, 2021, in a match against England at Bristol**
 
• She was named in India's squad for the one-off Test against England Women in 2021. 
 
• She was the **Player-of-the-Match in India's** ten-wicket win over South Africa in a one-off Test. 
 
• She made** her India debut in 2014 in a One Day International (ODI) match against Sri Lanka. **
 
 
 
• **Deepti Sharma****​**
 
 
• Deepti Sharma is the only Indian spinner to take six wickets in Women's One Day International Cricket.
 
• Deepti Sharma and Poonam Raut were the Indian women's cricket openers who scored 320 in 45.3 overs to become the world's first pair to achieve a 300-run opening wicket partnership in one-day internationals (ODIs).
 
• Deepti Sharma is a right-arm off-break bowler. Her 188 runs are the second-highest score in women's one-day international.
 
• Deepti Sharma and Poonam Raut batted for more than 45 overs to aggregate 320 at the top.
